title: Innovate 32 Partners With Houston’s Post Oak Dental
html:
Houston Practice Led by Dr. Chris Gowan Strengthens Nashville-Based Dental Services Platform’s Growing Presence in Houston

Innovate 32 (“Innovate” or the “Company”), a rapidly expanding, partner-driven dental services organization, announced its partnership with Post Oak Dental (“Post Oak” or “the practice”), a leading provider of comprehensive general and cosmetic dental care in Houston, Texas.

Under the leadership of Chief Executive Officer Josh Johnson, Innovate continues to expand its network of premier dental practices throughout the Southeast, Midwest, and Texas. The partnership with Post Oak builds on the Company’s existing presence in Houston and reflects a shared commitment to exceptional patient care, clinical excellence, and sustained practice growth.

Located in the Uptown area of Houston, Post Oak offers a full scope of preventive, restorative, and cosmetic dentistry. The practice is led by Dr. Chris Gowan, a native Houstonian with more than 30 years of experience in dentistry. Dr. Gowan studied at the University of Texas at Austin and the University of Texas Dental Branch at Houston. Known for meticulous attention to detail, a long-tenured clinical team, and patient relationships that span decades, Post Oak has built a loyal following across Houston. In partnership with Innovate 32, Dr. Gowan will continue to lead the practice’s clinical direction and patient care.

“Partnering with Innovate 32 allows us to keep doing what we do best: delivering exceptional, personalized dentistry to the patients who have trusted us for years while gaining the operational support to keep growing,” said Dr. Chris Gowan. “Innovate 32 understands that great practices are built on people and relationships. They respect our culture and our clinical standards, and I’m excited about what this partnership means for our team and our patients.”

The partnership with Post Oak marks another step in Innovate 32’s strategy to support growth-oriented clinicians, share best practices, and deliver superior patient experiences across the region.

“Post Oak Dental is exactly the kind of practice we look to partner with: led by an outstanding clinician, deeply trusted by its patients, and committed to the highest standard of care,” said Josh Johnson. “Post Oak strengthens our growing footprint in Houston. We’re proud to welcome Dr. Gowan and his entire team to the Innovate 32 family and look forward to supporting their continued success.”

Triumphant Partners served as the exclusive advisor to Post Oak Dental.

To learn more about partnerships with Innovate 32, please visit www.innovate32services.com.

About Innovate 32

Innovate 32 is a Nashville-based dental services organization that supports a growing network of premier dental practices, delivering best-in-class patient experiences through unmatched partner support. Innovate 32 provides essential management resources to empower its partners to remain focused on delivering exceptional care. Backed by Shore Capital, Innovate 32 is supported by a Board of Directors with deep experience in dentistry, operations, and private equity.

For more information, please visit www.innovate32services.com.
